comment: Registration input for course-repository content sources. Registered ContentSource rows are what decides which repositories exist; this file is only how a fresh database gets its first rows, in the same way scripts/production_like_course_specs.json seeds the course catalogue. Adding a repository here does not import it -- it makes it registerable, and `manage.py pull_course_repositories` or the signed push webhook does the rest. A repository without a course.yaml at its root cannot be ingested by either route, which is why mlops-zoomcamp and stock-markets-analytics-zoomcamp are absent.
